AppwriteAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In your project's Settings → API keys, create a key with databases.read for connection verification and the scopes needed by your actions. Triggers need webhooks.write. Paste the project ID, API endpoint (including /v1), and key. Self-hosted endpoints must be publicly reachable HTTPS URLs.

ttl.description: TTL (seconds) for caching list responses. Responses are stored in an in-memory key-value cache, keyed per project, table, schema version (columns and indexes), caller authorization roles, and the exact query — so users with different permissions never share cached entries. Schema changes invalidate cached entries automatically; row writes do not, so choose a TTL you are comfortable serving as stale data. Set to 0 to disable caching. Must be between 0 and 86400 (24 hours).
